en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 17. My father and all of my scholars narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn ‘Ali ibn ‘Ubayd Al-Ju’fi, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Jarīr Al-Qummi, who said: I heard Abal Ḥasan (Imam Riďa (a.s.)) say to my father:
Those who go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.) knowing his rights will be speaking with Allāh on top of His Throne (on the Day of Judgment).
“Verily the pious ones will be amidst gardens and springs in the seat of truth, in the presence of the omnipotent sovereign” (54:54-55).
